en: Black-and-white view of a harbor scene taken from a boat, with rigging and part of the vessel visible in the foreground. Across the water are quays, cranes, industrial buildings, piles of lumber or raw materials, and a docked passenger or cargo ship. Forested hills rise behind the town. Caption text in Swedish appears along the bottom margin, along with a photographer/publisher credit.
